data.message: {% for e in states('sensor.any_low_battery').split(', ') %}{{ e if e.startswith('+') else ((state_attr(e, 'friendly_name') or e) | replace(' Battery', '')) ~ ' ' ~ (states(e) | float(0) | round(0) | int) ~ '%' }}{{ ', ' if not loop.last }}{% endfor %}
data.title: Batteries to replace

description: A daily notice (09:00), and one the moment the first battery drops under 20 %, naming every low battery and its level. sensor.any_low_battery lists entity ids (and a last '+N more' item when the list is cut); this message turns them into names. Phones, the car and the vacuums are excluded by the sensor itself. To Vadim's phone only.
